domain: open axis: gross-profitability / quality-margin family on the death-inclusive cohort, built ENTIRELY from the hash-pinned multi-vintage PIT fundamentals panel (V9 sha256 67591464ee49acc159886143a379bda5890b1df602818b600d7938df92af1447) and the staged death-inclusive EODHD price store. No new vendor leg, no second EODHD field family (none has P2 coverage this cycle). The price leg is used only for eligibility, band assignment, fills, exits and benchmark context; no price-, volume- or return-derived observable enters any exposure; no share-count field enters any exposure (V11 A6 ancestry exclusion); no revision direction, no timing-lag and no amendment-chain observable is cited as signal.
title: Gross profitability is a real, persistent firm property that thin-attention capital prices slowly: long high gross-profit-to-asset vintages, short low, within-sector, market-neutral, on the death-inclusive cohort

named_literature: Novy-Marx (2013), 'The Other Side of Value: The Gross Profitability Premium', Journal of Financial Economics 108(1) - gross profit (revenue minus cost of goods sold) over total assets has roughly the same power predicting the cross-section of average returns as book-to-market; it is a genuinely distinct priced signal, robust in small/micro caps and within industries

Fama & French (2015), 'A Five-Factor Asset Pricing Model', Journal of Financial Economics 116(1) - the profitability premium (RMW/PC) survives as a priced factor alongside value, and absorbs the anomalies that profitability explains
Fama & French (2008), 'Dissecting Anomalies', Journal of Finance 63(4) - profitability among the robust cross-sectional predictors including micro caps, the cohort's population

Asness, Frazzini & Pedersen (2019), 'Quality Minus Junk', Review of Accounting Studies 24(1) - quality (profitability first among its pillars) earns a persistent premium, strongest in the hard-to-arbitrage names this cohort consists of

Hirshleifer & Teoh (2003), 'Limited Attention, Information Disclosure, and Financial Reporting', Journal of Accounting and Economics 36 - low-salience, slow-moving firm properties are under-impounded by attention-constrained investors

Duffie (2010), 'Asset Price Dynamics with Slow-Moving Capital', Journal of Finance 65(4) - why persistent-characteristic premia decay over weeks-to-quarters rather than sessions, the persistence floor for a 21-session hold
mechanism_lineage.economic_story: Gross profit over assets is the cleanest available statement of the firm's underlying production profitability: it sits above SG&A and below the line items most contaminated by accounting choices, it is highly persistent (Novy-Marx 2013 documents multi-year persistence), and it is not anybody's headline number - it must be assembled from two low-salience filing lines. Attention-constrained investors under-impound persistent profitability (Hirshleifer-Teoh 2003), so high-GP/A firms keep earning more than they promise and low-GP/A firms keep disappointing; slow-moving capital makes the correction take weeks (Duffie 2010), which is what a 21-session holding window harvests. In a death-inclusive cohort the effect has a second face: distressed and dying names are dominated by structurally unprofitable producers, and the premium for holding the profitable minority of a cohort nobody can index is compensation for exactly the limits-to-arbitrage burden (no benchmark product contains 1,647 of these dead-tail names) that keeps the anomaly un-arbitraged here.

falsifiable_prediction: The within-sector demeaned gross-profitability book (gross 1.0, net approximately 0, event-staggered decisions at V12-S3 structure-complete instants, 21-session holds, 3 folds) has positive expectancy AFTER base band costs, position PF >= 1.10, >= 2 of 3 folds positive expectancy, max fold MDD <= 15%, risk-matched SPY-excess expectancy > 0 overall and in >= 2 folds, and the permutation control's expectancy is NOT same-sign >= 0.5x the anchor's (and never outruns a negative anchor). The family is FALSIFIED if any of: anchor expectancy <= 0 after base costs; the control reproduces the anchor per the frozen falsification rule (same-sign >= 0.5x -> DEAD); pooled novelty |rho| > 0.20 vs any of the THIRTEEN veto entries at D2, measured pre-selection on conditioning exposures; self-subsumption rho > 0.98 between anchor and control exposures (design failure, kills pre-score); drop-one survival fails; the 2x stress rerun is nonpositive; reproduction is not ALL_MATCH. REJECT is a successful outcome; no gate is weakened to admit a thin margin (P-2 margins recorded, never traded away).

universe.eligibility: at each decision instant a name is eligible iff: (i) >= 63 bars through the decision session in its own series (history floor only); (ii) band C or better (ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD; UNTRADABLE excluded at decision); (iii) RAW close >= 1.00 USD; (iv) a valid PIT exposure: a strictly positive revenue-and-COGS pair and a strictly positive assets value, each from the latest evidenced vintage whose first_avail stamp is strictly before the decision-session start-of-day and within the 800-day staleness bound (else abstain fail-closed).
universe.dead_name_semantics: preregistered: a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on the final session (exit-at-last-close; the delisting return is carried by the death-inclusive price series itself); fill-check enforced (a missing bar at the fill session means the order does not exist - no synthetic continuation, no substitute pricing); no post-series prices read, interpolated or synthesized; no survivorship re-substitution; no arm requires a price after any series' last bar; zero-window instants are structurally unbookable and are counted and excluded-with-reason, never silently dropped.

clock.conditioner_definition: for entity i at decision instant tau: GP_i(tau) = REV_last_i(tau) - COGS_last_i(tau) and A_i(tau) = ASSETS_last_i(tau), where REV_last / COGS_last / ASSETS_last are the latest evidenced values of the entity's revenue, cost-of-goods and assets fields whose first_avail stamps are strictly before decision-session start-of-day, all within the 800-day bound; exposure X_i(tau) = GP_i(tau) / A_i(tau). No price, volume, share-count, revision, timing or chain input enters X.

Positions hold 21 sessions (the carried V8-V11 window) or until forced exit; books aggregate across entities per session; force-flat with cost at every fold boundary. warmup_rationale: 3 spans = 63 sessions of price history for the ADV63 band assignment and the >= 63-bar eligibility floor; the exposure itself needs no expanding history beyond its latest evidenced vintage stamps, so no additional abstention is declared; any decision may abstain fail-closed if the cohort scoreable floor (30) or a leg floor (5) is unmet.
entry_exit_fills: band-resolved house fills: signals computed from PIT stamps strictly before the decision session and bars through session t-1 (eligibility, ADV63 band); orders filled at the NEXT session, close-to-close, no same-session fill (STRICT_NEXT_BAR); fill-check: a name without a bar at the fill session simply does not fill (its order does not exist; legs are NOT renormalized - realized gross is reported); holding one 21-session span; force-flat with cost at fold boundaries; L-I3 fail-closed band resolution throughout (research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py); dead-name exit at last recorded close per universe.dead_name_semantics, charged per resolve_exit_band_bps (C-rate ceiling when the exit band is unrateable).

book_form.form: sector-residual daily long/short under the §2.1 provision (book_form_provision_2_1 carried VERBATIM in p3_v12_invariants_freeze.json), implemented as WITHIN-SECTOR DEMEANED weights - no ETF legs exist in any arm.
book_form.frozen_justification: profitability is industry-sticky: Novy-Marx (2013) shows the gross-profitability premium is strongest within industries, and Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen (2019) build quality industry-neutral for the same reason. Without demeaning, the book harvests sector drift - the program's most repeated measured killer (sector beta drowning; sector-exposure form is a veto entry). The §2.1 provision exists for exactly this mechanism-justified case, and the justification is frozen HERE before selection. Sector tags come from the cohort classes the census already uses for sham matching (p0 sham_placebo.matching_rule uses the cohort sector tag) - staged data, no new field.
book_form.implementation: within each cohort sector tag s, demean X_i; leg weights w_i proportional to the demeaned exposure scaled by 1.4826 * MAD (the frozen min_hist_frozen scale convention); long positive, short negative, normalized to gross 1.0 (0.5 per leg); abstain if either leg < 5 names or the cohort scoreable floor < 30 valid exposures is unmet. D2 novelty is measured on the CONDITIONING exposure X (which contains zero sector content), per the P3 provision.
book_form.dead_leg_honesty: exit-at-last-close on DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED legs; no post-death window is booked in any arm (the post-death reorg/survival semantics of NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL names never touch this family - those names are excluded at the universe level).

costs.model: p3_v12_invariants_freeze.json carried payload, verbatim: 'band model A/B/C 10/15/25 bps per side base, stress x2 applied to booked PnL; costs linear in fills; charged exactly once per fill'. Kernel: BAND_BPS = {"A": 10.0, "B": 15.0, "C": 25.0}; band_of(ADV63): >= 50,000,000 A, >= 10,000,000 B, >= 2,000,000 C, else UNTRADABLE; entries never use the UNTRADABLE path.
costs.application: costs linear in fills (|dw| x band bps x multiplier / 10,000), charged exactly once per fill per side, applied to BOOKED PnL; no sidecar, no accrual-by-stamp.
costs.resolution: L-I3 fail-closed: a traded name without a computed band raises BandResolutionError; the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden; terminal/exit fills of names whose band has become UNTRADABLE or missing are charged the C-rate ceiling (25 bps base / 50 stress) per resolve_exit_band_bps - a computed conservative resolution, never a default.
costs.stress: stress tier = x2 multiplier on booked PnL (20/30/50 bps); gate: stress PnL > 0 and stress PF >= 1.0.

arms.spec: At each decision instant: within-sector demeaned continuous weights on X = GP/A as defined in book_form (long high gross-profitability, short low; equal gross 0.5/0.5; no magnitude cap beyond the MAD scale; no sector, price, share-count or chain input in X). Abstains fail-closed on the frozen floors.

Same machinery, eligibility, clock, book form and floors, with the exposure recomputed as the gross MARGIN X' = (REV - COGS)/REV - the sales-denominated form of the same numerator, with the assets denominator deleted entirely. Materially different construction, declared mechanism content: margin isolates pricing power and removes the balance-sheet scale that mechanically couples GP/A to firm size and cash-heavy balance sheets; a margin-only result with the same sign supports the mechanism, while a result that exists ONLY through the assets denominator downweights the family (the scale, not the production profitability, would be the priced object).

Deterministic within-decision, WITHIN-SECTOR permutation placebo (matched-null): at each scored decision, the anchor's exposure VALUES are permuted across that decision's eligible names INSIDE each cohort sector tag using a frozen deterministic hash order (sha256 of the string cycle|{hypothesis_id}|{cik}|{decision_index}, hex-sorted - no RNG library, byte-reproducible). The permutation preserves the exact cross-sectional and within-sector distribution of exposures, the exact eligibility set, the exact demeaning and MAD-scale machinery, and all fill/cost/dead-leg machinery, while destroying the name-to-profitability link. RUNNABILITY by construction: it abstains exactly where the anchor abstains and can never abort on data semantics (forex V3 lesson); every input is a PIT panel stamp and a staged price bar. Refutation semantics: if the permuted book reproduces the anchor (>= 0.5x same-sign expectancy, or outrunning the anchor including the negative-anchor case), the priced object was size, sector composition or cohort structure rather than production profitability, and the family dies per the frozen falsification-by-control rule. This control knowingly walks into the cluster's gunsight; that is its purpose.

exposure_definition: Per entity i at decision instant tau, for the D2 rank-correlation screen against each of the THIRTEEN veto entries on the same decision x entity cohort: EXPOSURE_i(tau) = (REV_last_i(tau) - COGS_last_i(tau)) / ASSETS_last_i(tau), all three values from evidenced vintages stamped strictly before tau and inside the 800-day bound; the name is unscored at tau if any input is missing, non-positive, or stale (abstain, counted). Primary revenue field per entity = the priority-ordered revenue field with the most period groups in the panel (ties broken by priority order us-gaap:Revenues > us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax); COGS priority us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold > us-gaap:CostOfRevenue; assets us-gaap:Assets. Ranking direction for D2: DESCENDING exposure (most profitable = rank 1). Inputs are exactly the evidenced panel stamps and values plus each stamp's own availability evidence; no price, volume, share-price, share-count, sector, revision, timing-lag, chain or cash-flow-statement field enters the exposure. D2 computes pooled Spearman rho of this exposure vs each veto-entry exposure; pooled |rho| <= 0.20 required, measured pre-selection; hedged relabellings die.

incremental_alpha_test: per the frozen factor_and_benchmark contract carried from V8/V9/V10: arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross rule), per fold and overall; gate: overall SPY-excess expectancy > 0 and >= 2 of 3 folds positive; secondary equal-weight 11-SPDR sector-ETF factor reported per fold (reported, not gated - the within-sector demeaned book has no sector bet to gate and no ETF legs). ETF-share gate <= 0.50 where ETF legs exist: NOT_APPLICABLE ex-ante (declared in stage_a_gate_table); SPY-excess positivity gates as stated. The book is approximately net-neutral by construction, so the alpha gate binds on mechanism absence, not beta dressing.
turnover_and_sample_floor: >= 30 scored decisions overall and >= 5 per fold (binding minimum; expected counts from the S3 census scale are far above the floor - A9 verifies from the frozen calendar, structure only). Per-span one-way turnover from the 21-session holding is structurally ~1x gross per span plus exits; every fill is charged exactly once per the cost contract; dead-leg exits add fills at death and are charged at the C-ceiling resolution. If floors abstain the family under count, the verdict is INFEASIBLE (declared in stage_a_gate_table), never a silently reduced book.
drop_one_design: (1) drop-one-symbol: rerun excluding the max-contribution name; survival iff after-drop expectancy > 0. (2) drop-one-fold: expectancy recomputed with each fold removed; survival iff min over folds > 0. (3) drop-one-field: rerun with each priority revenue/COGS tag excluded in turn as primary (field-priority sensitivity of the coverage rule, not a parameter search - the declared reruns only). All reruns inherit identical eligibility, bands, fills, costs, book form and dead-name semantics.

frozen_thresholds.field_priority: us-gaap:Revenues > us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax (revenue); us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold > us-gaap:CostOfRevenue (COGS); us-gaap:Assets - a declared evidence-quality ordering (total-revenue line > contract-revenue line; full COGS line > narrow cost-of-revenue line), frozen ex-ante, no alternative ordering exists in any arm.
frozen_thresholds.weight_scale_1.4826_MAD: the frozen min_hist_frozen scale convention (p3 carried payload) applied to the within-sector demeaned exposure; no other normalization exists.
frozen_thresholds.staleness_800d: every conditioning input inside the 800-day bound (P2 verbatim rule).
frozen_thresholds.decision_threshold_ge5_strict_bars: an S3 instant funds a decision iff the entity has >= 5 strict bookable bars after last_avail (census-measured threshold from p2/p0 counts; a coverage constant, not a tuned filter).
frozen_thresholds.window_21_sessions: one holding span; characteristic premia are documented over weeks-to-quarters (Duffie 2010) and the holding equals one carried grid step - the construction the program's accounting contract is priced for; not re-tuned anywhere.
frozen_thresholds.per_entity_thinning_1_per_21s: capacity honesty: at most one NEW position per entity per 21-session span (first qualifying instant); declared constant, no grid.
frozen_thresholds.cohort_scoreable_floor_30: mirrors the frozen min_hist_cohort = 30 convention of the P0 observable layer.
frozen_thresholds.leg_floor_5_names: inherited accounting minimum (>= 1 non-degenerate leg per scored decision with meaningful equal-weight dispersion).
frozen_thresholds.gross_1.0_half_per_leg: cross-sectional mechanism expressed market-neutral; beta dressing is the confound this design must not enter.

no_parameter_grid_declaration: one field priority, one weight scale, one staleness bound, one decision threshold, one holding window, one thinning constant, one floor per concept - all frozen above with stated rationale; no grid search over windows, thresholds, terciles, universes, top-K, field orderings or costs anywhere in any arm; the neighbour changes exactly one thing (the denominator of the exposure) and the control changes exactly one thing (name assignment within sector), both declared; drop-one reruns are declared diagnostics with no admission path back into the family parameters.
